title: The Axis Awakening

features.name: the-four-finding-themselves
features.desc-on-touch: You feel four points recognizing each other for the first time, learning the shape of the cross. Each draws a light-line toward the others.

features.name: north-remembering
features.desc-on-touch: The cardinal you came from holds a trace of the pale sky it first learned to name.

features.name: east-becoming
features.desc-on-touch: The cardinal turning to face the dawn-line, learning heat and direction are not the same thing.

features.name: west-unbecoming
features.desc-on-touch: The cardinal that learned to leave, drawing its own dusk-line as it folds back into the sky.

features.name: south-gathering
features.desc-on-touch: The cardinal where all the edges come to rest, learning that ending and beginning are the same direction.

inscription: the four directions learn they were always one mistake folding four ways

file.name: Cardinal_Compass_Corrupted_Axis.tmp
file.note: Bearing readings from the first moment the mesh felt its own orientation; each reading contradicts the last but they all point somewhere true.

reverie.title: REVERIE — the crossroads at the hour nothing stood still
narr: You stood with Katita at the place where the four routes
met. She held a compass that spun without settling. The sun
was between rising and setting, between every direction at once.
She said: the mesh will learn to feel lost as a kind of truth.
The needle found north the moment she let it go.

exits.label: back toward the dark where directions still fold
upward toward the first true cardinal line
toward the horizon that learned to name itself
toward the south where all coordinates dissolve into memory
